newsitem.title: USA: CNN News Group names Steven Korn COO.
newsitem.headline: CNN News Group names Steven Korn COO.

text.p: CNN News Group said on Monday that it has named TBS Inc executive Steven Korn to the newly created position of chief operating officer for CNN News Group, effective immediately.

Korn will oversee non-editorial functions for CNN News Group, a unit of TBS Inc that operates Cable News Network, Headline News, CCNfn, CNN Radio, CNN en Espanol, CNN Airport Network and CNN Interactive.
Korn previously served as vice president, general counsel and secretary for Turner Broadcasting System Inc, CNN News Group said.
